population.name: singapore_street_v1
limits: Residents only: 4.23 of 6.21 million people at end-June 2026. And who lives here is not who is out walking: Elche's observers saw 15.9% aged over 65, this profile gives 21.3%.
A cane comes from the United States (2011) and a phone from Spain (2019): no Singapore figure was found for either. A cane "in the last month" overstates one in hand at a given moment.
A large suitcase, a cane under 65 and assertiveness are placeholders. A suitcase depends most on the place; 1% is for a street only.
The factors are given independently of each other within an age band: no source gives, say, a cane and a phone together.
